text: The bit pattern 11000000 10101000 00001010 01000110 has an intrinsic meaning that can be determined by inspection.
explanation: False. Under an agreement that this is an IPv4 address it is 192.168.10.70; as an unsigned big-endian integer it is 3,232,238,150; as four ASCII characters it is mostly unprintable. Meaning comes from a shared agreement about how to read the bits, never from the bits alone — which is why a mismatched agreement produces confident nonsense rather than an error.
